name: Docs listing and backlink outreach
summary: Get docs.example.com listed on the curated resource pages and awesome-lists our audience already reads. Ten ranked targets, three templates, one send plan.
voice: Short, specific, no marketing adjectives. Lead with what the reader's audience gets. One ask per message. Disclose that it is our project.

targets.name: awesome-example-tools
targets.contact: Pull request following CONTRIBUTING.md — one line, alphabetical, matching the existing entry format
targets.angle: The list has no interactive tutorial entry; ours is free and needs no account
targets.value: durable backlink from a 4k-star repo; steady referral traffic
targets.likelihood: high — the list accepts PRs weekly and has no competing entry
targets.evidence: 17 open PRs merged in the last 60 days; two comparable tools listed

targets.name: Example University — course resource page
targets.contact: Instructor email on the syllabus page
targets.angle: The course's week 4 assignment covers exactly what our getting-started guide teaches
targets.value: .edu link; seasonal traffic at semester start
targets.likelihood: medium — instructors reply in batches at term boundaries
targets.evidence: Resource page updated each August; links to two similar tools

templates.subject: Add docs.example.com (interactive getting-started, no account needed)
templates.body:
Hi —

PR attached adding docs.example.com under Tutorials. It's our project (disclosure), free, runs in the browser without an account, and covers the same ground as the two guides already listed but interactively.

Happy to trim to one line or move sections if you prefer.

Thanks for maintaining the list.

templates.subject: A free interactive companion to your week-4 material
templates.body:
Hi Professor —

I build docs.example.com, a free interactive guide to <topic>. Your 101 course's week-4 assignment covers the same concepts, and a few students have told us they used the guide alongside it.

If it would be useful to list on the course resources page, here is the link: https://docs.example.com/getting-started. No account, no tracking beyond standard analytics.

Either way, thank you for teaching this.

— <your name>

plan.notes: Read CONTRIBUTING.md first; match the entry format exactly

plan.action: Email the two instructors whose fall syllabi are already posted
plan.notes: Personalize the week reference for each

plan.action: Check PR feedback; edit the existing PR rather than opening a new one

week2: Follow up on unanswered instructor emails once, then stop. Move to the next three targets.
later: Once the awesome-list entry is merged, cite it in the next two pitches as social proof.
cautions: Never send the same template to two maintainers of the same list.
Disclose that it is your project every time.
